name: Chernobog
title: Bleak Anathema
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Chernobog is the avatar of disaster and ill fortune. Harm follows in his wake, and he delights in the suffering he brings. Fighting for Vyraj in his own way, Chernobog extends his hand into other Realms. Bad luck surges beneath his gaze, and he has raised monsters and spirits to sally forth in his name, carrying his powers of mischance with them.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

Place [Phoenix] on this hero for 1 turn which does not reduce on turn.
After 5 enemy turns, if this hero is defeated, revive this hero with 100% HP and Turn Meter. If Belobog is an ally, remove [Banish] and [Block Revive] before reviving.
